easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 20 or higher.
description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}, preventing you from losing the game this turn.
Cast Transcendence by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Transcendence triggers due to you having 20 or more life. However, you cannot lose the game due to Angel's Grace.
Step 3 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
